cues.en: For instance, readers block other readers, which is kind of a shame because they're not really going to interfere with each other. But because you're locking as a reader to prevent a writer from messing you up, You're also locking out other readers.
cues.zh: 比如，读者会阻塞其他读者，这挺可惜的，因为他们其实不会互相干扰。但因为读者加锁是为了防止写者捣乱，你同时也把其他读者锁在外面了。

cues.zh: 那我们来比较这两种并发方式。第一种是我所说的传统方式。如果你没用非常特殊的东西，今天就得这么做。

cues.zh: 据我所知，Java 或 C 没有什么特殊方案，我是说专门的语言或能替你做到这一点的东西。

cues.en: And I really want to talk about two things. One is what's the structure of your program? I mentioned mutable objects or whatever, but there's a structural aspect to a program written with mutable objects. And that is that that program is composed of direct references
cues.zh: 我真正想谈两点。一是你的程序结构是什么？我提到过可变对象之类，但用可变对象写的程序有一个结构层面的特点。那就是这个程序由直接引用组成，

cues.en: to things that can change.
cues.zh: 指向那些可能变化的东西。

cues.en: That's your typical C or Java program. It's full of references,
cues.zh: 这就是典型的 C 或 Java 程序。它充满了引用，

cues.en: direct references to things that can change. As soon as you've done that architecturally,
cues.zh: 直接指向可能变化的东西。一旦你在架构上这么做了，

cues.en: you are stuck with this locking
cues.zh: 你就被这套加锁的东西困住了。

cues.en: stuff. There's nothing else you could do.
cues.zh: 没别的办法。

cues.en: And what do you do? You lock and you hope for the best.
cues.zh: 那你会怎么做？加锁，然后祈祷一切顺利。

cues.en: The aspects of this that are bad are it's manual as we saw.
cues.zh: 这其中糟糕的地方在于，正如我们看到的，它是手工的。

cues.en: We have to choose to lock and everything is convention. Every application has to decide we're locking A before B, we're locking in alphabetical order, there's a lock over here for these three things. Don't forget to lock that when you do this. Right? Where does all that stuff go? It's not in the programming language. It's on napkins or in some doc somewhere or whatever in some guy's head,
cues.zh: 我们必须选择加锁，而且一切都靠约定。每个应用都得决定：我们先锁 A 再锁 B，我们按字母顺序加锁，这三个东西在这里有一把锁。做这个的时候别忘了锁那个。对吧？这些东西都放哪儿？它不在编程语言里。它在餐巾纸上，或在某处的文档里，或在某人的脑子里，

cues.en: But it is not in your program, unfortunately,
cues.zh: 但不幸的是，它不在你的程序里，

cues.en: and that's bad.
cues.zh: 这很糟糕。

cues.en: We'll contrast that with the closure way. Then what closure does is two things. We have this
cues.zh: 我们把它和 Clojure 的方式对比一下。Clojure 做的是两件事。我们有这个

cues.en: immutable persistent data structures, which we talked about. And then we have the acknowledgement that there will be programs in which you need to feel like those things are changing.
cues.zh: 不可变的持久化数据结构，这个我们之前讲过。然后我们还承认，有些程序里你会需要感觉到这些东西在变化。

cues.en: So rather than have them actually change, because we don't want data structures to change, what we're going do is we're going to have a reference to something
cues.zh: 所以我们不是让它们真的变化——因为我们不希望数据结构发生变化——我们要做的是，用一个指向某个东西的引用

cues.en: and we're going to keep that reference around. That'll be a stable reference.
cues.zh: 然后一直保留这个引用。它会是一个稳定的引用。

cues.en: But what it refers to, that can change.
cues.zh: 但它所指的内容，是可以变的。

cues.en: So therefore that reference is indirect,
cues.zh: 这样一来，这个引用就是间接的，

cues.en: right? It's sort of a pointer.
cues.zh: 对吧？它有点像一个指针。

cues.en: It's a cell that holds a pointer to a thing. The cell will always be able to keep track of. The pointer to the thing, that may change. So this cell can mutate. It's an atomic thing that can mutate and what they're called enclosure is references.
cues.zh: 它是一个单元格，里面保存着指向某个东西的指针。这个单元格始终能被追踪到，而指向那个东西的指针可能会变。所以这个单元格是可变的。它是一个可以变异的原子性的东西，在 Clojure 里它们被称为引用（references）。

cues.en: So the different architecture enclosure is you have indirect references
cues.zh: 所以 Clojure 的不同架构就是：你拥有间接引用，

cues.en: to things that could never change,
cues.zh: 指向那些永远不会变的东西，

cues.en: but those references can be made to refer to other things
cues.zh: 但让这些引用在应用程序的运行过程中

cues.en: over the course of an application. That gives you the same effect. Right? When we had direct references to things that can change, I could remember Fred
cues.zh: 改指向别的东西。这就达到了同样的效果，对吧？当我们直接引用可变的东西时，我可以记住 Fred

cues.en: and I could look at Fred at one point in the program and it would be, something.
cues.zh: 然后在程序的某个位置查看 Fred，它是某个东西。

cues.en: I can look at Fred at another part of the program and it would be something else.
cues.zh: 再在程序的另一个位置查看 Fred，它就变成了另一个东西。

cues.en: This can achieve the same effect. I have a reference. I'm going to call it reference Fred.
cues.zh: 这能达到同样的效果。我有一个引用，就叫它引用 Fred。

cues.en: At one point in the program, it refers to this.
cues.zh: 在程序中的某个位置，它指向这个。

cues.en: At another point in the program, it refers to that. Same feel, I'll look at Fred, I'll get different information.
cues.zh: 在程序的另一个位置，它指向那个。感觉一样，我看 Fred，会得到不同的信息。

cues.en: The difference is this is indirect,
cues.zh: 区别在于这是间接的，

cues.en: right? I don't really have a point to this data structure or that data structure. I have a reference
cues.zh: 对吧？我并不是真的指向这个数据结构或那个数据结构。我有一个引用

cues.en: that I hold onto.
cues.zh: 我持有它。

cues.en: And that those references can change. So now here's the part of closure that's mutable.
cues.zh: 而且这些引用可以改变。所以现在到了闭包中可变的部分。

cues.en: This is the first thing so far I've talked about in closure that's mutable. Nothing else you saw. None of the strings, characters,
cues.zh: 这是我到目前为止讲到的闭包中第一个可变的东西。你看到的其他都不是。字符串、字符，

cues.en: all those data structures, lists, vectors, maps, sets.
cues.zh: 所有这些数据结构，列表、向量、映射、集合。

cues.en: None of that can change. The only thing that can change are these reference types.
cues.zh: 这些都不能改变。唯一能改变的是这些引用类型。

cues.en: And what's important about them is they have concurrency semantics.
cues.zh: 重要的是它们有并发语义。

cues.en: Because they're indirect, your program isn't just like twiddling them. Your program has to use functions to make them point to different things.
cues.zh: 因为它们是间接的，你的程序不能随便摆弄它们。程序必须用函数让它们指向不同的东西。

cues.en: And those functions have concurrency semantics,
cues.zh: 而这些函数有并发语义，

cues.en: which I'll talk about in a minute.
cues.zh: 我稍后会讲。

cues.en: Which means that they're automatic.
cues.zh: 这意味着它们是自动的。

cues.en: Right? The programming language is going to help you change these things to point to other things and not mess that up.
cues.zh: 对吧？编程语言会帮你把这些东西改成指向其他东西，而且不会搞乱。

cues.en: And it's enforced.
cues.zh: 而且这是强制执行的。

cues.en: For instance, some of these references can only be changed inside a transaction. Guess what? If try to change it outside of a transaction,
cues.zh: 比如，其中一些引用只能在事务内改变。猜怎么着？如果你试图在事务外改变它，

cues.en: it throws an exception. You can't do that.
cues.zh: 它会抛出异常。你不能那么做。

cues.en: So there's a big difference now between these two things. One, it's all convention. It's all manual. Things could change out from under you. In the other, things never change.
cues.zh: 所以现在这两者之间差别很大。一种完全靠约定，完全靠手动，情况可能在你脚下就变了。另一种则永远不变。

cues.en: Right? If you actually dereference one of these references, you would get an immutable object. If somebody makes that reference point to something else, do you care while you're looking at this and calculating?
cues.zh: 对吧？如果你真的解引用其中一个引用，得到的会是一个不可变对象。如果有人让这个引用指向别的东西，那么在你查看并计算的过程中，你会在意吗？

cues.en: No. This will never change while you're looking at it.
cues.zh: 不。只要你一直盯着它看，这就永远不会变。

cues.en: That's really beautiful.
cues.zh: 真的很美。

cues.en: And in the application program, there are no locks.
cues.zh: 而在应用程序里，没有锁。

cues.en: So there's no locking required to do any of the things
cues.zh: 所以，执行这些操作完全不需要加锁。

cues.en: concurrency wise that Clojure supports.
cues.zh: 就并发而言，也就是 Clojure 所支持的那些。

cues.en: So I said these things are generically called references.
cues.zh: 所以我说，这些统称为引用。

cues.en: That's kind of a little
cues.zh: 这有点小

cues.en: reuse of the word because you'll see one of the reference types is called ref.
cues.zh: 重复使用这个词，是因为你会看到其中一种引用类型就叫 ref。

cues.en: So don't get confused by that.
cues.zh: 所以别被这个搞糊涂了。

cues.en: So the references are the only things in closure that are closures. I mean, you can use Java in closure and all kinds of stuff can happen that can change because it's still Java. I don't protect you from the mutation that's associated with Java or side effects. You you go there, you do that.
cues.zh: 所以，在 Clojure 里，引用是唯一本身是闭包的东西。我的意思是，你可以在 Clojure 里用 Java，各种事情都可能发生、状态也可能改变，因为它仍然是 Java。Java 相关的可变性和副作用，我不会替你挡住。你既然去用它们，就得承担后果。

cues.en: But in closure,
cues.zh: 但在闭包中，

cues.en: only these references can change. They're the only thing that can really mutate. This is inspired by ML. In ML there's a thing called a reference and it's a really neat idea.
cues.zh: 只有这些引用可以改变。它们是唯一真正能发生变化的东西。这灵感来自机器学习。在机器学习里有个叫引用的东西，是个很巧妙的想法。

cues.en: It's the thing in ML that can change, standard ML I'm talking about here. It also has arrays, which I won't talk about. But the reference was kind of a neat idea. The problem for me in just copying that into Clojure was it has no concurrency semantics. In ML, it's just a free for all cell. But it was a neat thing because it was indirect
cues.zh: 这就是 ML 里可以变的那个东西，我这里说的是 Standard ML。它也有数组，这个我就不讲了。但引用（reference）这个想法挺巧妙的。对我来说，直接把它照搬到 Clojure 的问题是：它没有并发语义。在 ML 里，它就是一个完全自由、随便怎么用的单元。但它确实是个巧妙的点子，因为它是间接的。

cues.en: and you didn't need to make mutable composite data structures. If you have an easy way to turn one data structure into a changed version of itself, you don't really need data structures where you can twiddle the bits. Right? Because you can make those incremental changes cheaply.
cues.zh: 而且，你也不需要创建可变的复合数据结构。如果你能轻松地把一个数据结构转换成修改后的版本，那其实就不太需要那些可以随意修改内部位的数据结构了，对吧？因为这样你就能低成本地进行增量修改。

cues.en: So all you ever need is a is a reference that that you can change, and you just refer to changed versions.
cues.zh: 所以你需要的只是一个你能修改的引用，然后你去引用修改后的版本。

cues.en: So there are three types of these references in Clojure.
cues.zh: 在 Clojure 里有三种这样的引用。

cues.en: There are things called VARs,
cues.zh: 有一种叫 VAR，

cues.en: and a VAR
cues.zh: 而 VAR

cues.en: is used actually to hold global variables and functions.
cues.zh: 实际上是用来存放全局变量和函数的。

cues.en: So there's a global notion to a VAR. In addition, VARs have the ability to be bound to values
cues.zh: 所以 VAR 有一个全局的概念。此外，VAR 还能被绑定到值上，

cues.en: inside a thread. And once they're bound inside a thread,
cues.zh: 是在线程内部绑定。一旦它们在线程内被绑定，

cues.en: that,
cues.zh: 那个

cues.en: binding is independent of other threads. So I can bind a bar called X to a value in this thread. I can bind it to a different value in that thread and these threads can manipulate X completely independently
cues.zh: 绑定就与其他线程相互独立。所以我可以在这个线程里把名为 X 的 VAR 绑定到一个值，在那个线程里把它绑定到另一个不同的值，这些线程可以完全独立地操作 X，

cues.en: without interfering with each other. And when they're done with that binding, it unrolls like a stack. I'll explain that a little bit more, but the premise of VARs
cues.zh: 互不干扰。当它们用完这个绑定时，它会像栈一样展开。我稍后会再多解释一点，但 VAR 的前提是

cues.en: is that VARs are for isolating
cues.zh: VAR 是用来隔离

cues.en: changes within threads. This thread is the only one that will see what it does to X. This thread is the only one that will see what it does with X. That's one thing you need to do in programs.
cues.zh: 线程内的变更的。这个线程是唯一能看到它对 X 做了什么的存在。那个线程也是唯一能看到它对 X 做了什么的存在。这是你在程序里需要做的一件事。

cues.en: Another thing you need to do in programs is the most complex case.
cues.zh: 你在程序里需要做的另一件事，是最复杂的情况。

cues.en: It's the, I need to move this from this account to that account and I want to make sure it's in one account or the other, never in both and never in none. That's a really hard... I need to change two things. I need to make that whole change,
cues.zh: 就是，我需要把这笔钱从这个账户转到那个账户，我要确保它只在一个账户里，绝不同时在两个账户里，也绝不两个账户里都没有。这真的很难……我需要改两样东西。我需要让整个变更

cues.en: atomic.
cues.zh: 具有原子性。

cues.en: And for that, you need a transactional system. And the ref's enclosure
cues.zh: 要做到这一点，你需要一个事务性系统。而 ref 的封装

cues.en: are for that. So what are you doing there? You're sharing
cues.zh: 正是为此。那么你在那里做什么？你在共享

cues.en: values,
cues.zh: 值，

cues.en: you're sharing them synchronously,
cues.zh: 你在同步地共享它们，

cues.en: and you're sharing coordinated changes. REFs allow you to change more than one thing in a coordinated
cues.zh: 并且你在共享协调后的变更。REF 允许你在一个协调的

cues.en: operation.
cues.zh: 操作中改变不止一个东西。

cues.en: And
cues.zh: 而且

cues.en: those changes can be seen from multiple threads. So distinct from VARs, which are sort of hiding their changes in threads.
cues.zh: 这些变更可以被多个线程看到。所以这不同于 VAR，VAR 有点像是把变更隐藏在各自的线程里。

cues.en: Refs make changes that can be seen from multiple threads and it does that by using transactions.
cues.zh: Ref 做出的变更可以被多个线程看到，它通过使用事务来实现这一点。

cues.en: Again, I'm going to break each of these down.
cues.zh: 同样，我会把每一个都拆解开来。

cues.en: So second recipe. So now I want to change multiple things and do that atomically.
cues.zh: 所以第二个配方。现在我想改变多个东西，并且以原子方式做到。

cues.en: The third thing you might want to do is you might want to have,
cues.zh: 你可能想做的第三件事，是你可能想要有

cues.en: things change asynchronously
cues.zh: 异步变化的

cues.en: and independently,
cues.zh: 且相互独立的东西，

cues.en: but still be accessible from multiple threads.
cues.zh: 但仍然可以被多个线程访问。

cues.zh: 而 agent 就是第三种引用封装，

cues.en: support that.

cues.zh: 所以用 agent，你有一个可以变化的东西。

cues.zh: 你可以请求它变化，它最终会做到，但它会在自己的时间独立地去做。

cues.zh: 但其他线程可以看到

cues.zh: 这是完全不同的一种风格。你把它们用于不同目的。你会在我写的程序里看到，我要用 agent 和 ref。

cues.zh: 让事情发生。而 ref 则是必须以原子方式

cues.zh: 我只想说，如果你了解 Common Lisp，它们有点像 Common Lisp 中的特殊变量，

cues.en: kinds of programming.

cues.zh: 用于程序内部的事务系统通常被称为软件事务

cues.zh: And

cues.zh: 好，你知道数据库的 ACID

cues.en: database, well it can't be consistent because there's no
cues.zh: 中的那个，好吧，它没法保证一致性，因为没有

cues.en: constraints. It can't be durable because it's in memory.
cues.zh: 约束。它也没法保证持久性，因为它在内存里。

cues.en: But it has the other two
cues.zh: 但它具备另外两个特性

cues.en: Okay, it's atomic and isolated, which means that every change you make to a set of refs inside a transaction
cues.zh: 好，它是原子且隔离的，这意味着你在事务中对一组 ref 所做的每一个修改

cues.en: either happens or none of the changes you made happen.
cues.zh: 要么全部发生，要么你做的所有修改都不发生。

cues.en: Okay, so that's the atomic.
cues.zh: 好，这就是原子性。

cues.en: Everybody understands that, I think, let's use a database.
cues.zh: 我想大家都理解这一点，让我们用数据库来类比。

cues.en: The other thing is,
cues.zh: 另一件事是，

cues.en: that they're isolated. So while you're mucking about in your transaction, you don't see
cues.zh: 它们是隔离的。所以当你在事务里折腾的时候，你看不到

cues.en: the effects of other transactions and they don't see yours until one or the other commits.
cues.zh: 其他事务的影响，它们也看不到你的，直到其中一方提交。

cues.en: A big difference with transactions in the software transactional memory system, at least once most of them are implemented this way, is that transactions are speculative and they're automatically retried.
cues.zh: 软件事务内存系统中的事务与数据库事务的一大区别——至少大多数实现都是这样——是事务是推测性的，而且会自动重试。

cues.en: So if I want to move something from A to B and you want to move something from A to B and then we both get in and you win, like you get there first,
cues.zh: 所以，如果我想把某个东西从 A 移到 B，你也想把某个东西从 A 移到 B，然后我们俩都进来操作而你赢了，比如你先到了，

cues.en: I don't get a failure.
cues.zh: 我不会得到一个失败。

cues.en: My transaction will automatically retry.
cues.zh: 我的事务会自动重试。

cues.en: I'll be second.
cues.zh: 我排第二。

cues.en: So that's a unique part, that the transactions were retried. You sort of get that effect with the database, but mostly by locking. They just block you until now sometimes you get in there, you start doing your work, only to find out, Oh,
cues.zh: 所以这是一个独特之处：事务会被重试。用数据库你也能得到类似的效果，但那主要是靠加锁。它们只是阻塞你，直到——有时候你进去了，开始干活，结果才发现，哦，

cues.en: can't get out this piece I needed to change or somebody else changed it.
cues.zh: 我要改的那部分拿不到，或者别人已经改过了。

cues.en: But so they'll be automatically retried. A key thing about that is, therefore your transaction cannot have any side effects in it. Right? If you make a Java call that says Print,
cues.zh: 而这里事务会被自动重试。关键的一点是，因此你的事务里不能有任何副作用，对吧？如果你调用一个 Java 的打印方法，

cues.en: well guess what?
cues.zh: 那猜猜会怎样？

cues.en: You may be automatically retried. You may be automatically retried dozens of times. You're getting a lot of print statements. So no side effects are allowed in transactions. You have to only manipulate refs in transactions. Is there an option that if you have something happening, you say, if I'm not first there, then
cues.zh: 你的事务可能会自动重试，可能会自动重试几十次，你就会打出一大堆打印语句。所以事务里不允许有副作用，你在事务里只能操作 ref。那有没有这样一个选项：当有什么事情发生时，你说，如果我不是第一个到的，

cues.en: don't retry. Is there a way to disable that automation?
cues.zh: 就不要重试。有没有办法禁用这种自动机制？

cues.en: What tends to happen is that you're going to be looking at data in your transaction.
cues.zh: 实际情况往往是，你在事务里会去读取一些数据。

cues.en: And when you retry that situation that said year ago is not true anymore.
cues.zh: 而当你重试时，一年前成立的那种情况已经不成立了。

cues.en: Therefore you will abort
cues.zh: 因此你会中止

cues.en: because your conditional says, I can't do my job now. If you can, then you will.
cues.zh: 因为你的条件判断说：我现在没法完成我的工作了。如果还能完成，那你就继续执行。

cues.en: So that's how it works. There are some transaction systems
cues.zh: 所以它就是这样运作的。还有一些事务系统

cues.en: in Haskell that have like an if else notion,
cues.zh: 在Haskell里，有类似if else的概念，

cues.en: but I really feel that that's merging a transaction system with a coordination system and I don't think it's a good idea.
cues.zh: 但我真的觉得，这是在把事务系统和协调系统混在一起，我认为这不是个好主意。

cues.en: So a little bit of details about the STM Enclosure. It's very
cues.zh: 关于STM Enclosure的一些细节。它非常

cues.en: neat,
cues.zh: 不错，

cues.en: in its implementation.
cues.zh: 在其实现中。

cues.en: Certainly from a user standpoint, it's the easiest thing you can think of. You wrap
cues.zh: 当然，从用户角度看，这是你能想到的最简单的事。你包装

cues.en: your code with this sync thing, do sync,
cues.zh: 你的代码配合这个同步的东西，做同步，

cues.en: and anything that you do inside that is in a transaction. That includes any calls you make, any calls those calls make, etcetera, etcetera. That's a dynamic scope of the transaction. If another transaction is started underneath it, it's absorbed by the
cues.zh: 在它里面你所做的一切都在一个事务中。这包括你发起的任何调用、这些调用再发起的调用，等等。这就是事务的动态作用域。如果在它下面又启动了另一个事务，它会被外层……

cues.en: parent transaction. So they'll all happen or nothing will happen.
cues.zh: 父事务。因此，它们要么全部发生，要么全都不发生。

cues.en: And that's it.
cues.zh: 就是这样。

cues.en: You
cues.zh: 你theyweyou alleveryonefolksguysteamfriendscolleagues

cues.en: say do sync and you manipulate references inside that.
cues.zh: 说 do sync，然后你操作其中的引用。

cues.en: And magically,
cues.zh: 神奇的是，

cues.en: that work is atomic.
cues.zh: 这项工作具有原子性。

cues.en: And it's
cues.zh: 而且它……

cues.en: magic.
cues.zh: 魔法。

cues.en: Under the hood, it's really, really complicated.
cues.zh: 在底层，它真的非常非常复杂。

cues.en: Enclosures STM
cues.zh: 封闭式 STM（Enclosures）

cues.en: is kind of unique in that it uses multi version concurrency control. Does anybody know what that is?
cues.zh: 它比较独特的一点是使用了多版本并发控制。有人知道这是什么吗？

cues.en: Anybody use Oracle
cues.zh: 有人用 Oracle 吗？

cues.en: or PostgreSQL?
cues.zh: 还是 PostgreSQL？

cues.en: Those are database systems that use multi version concurrency control. The idea behind multi version concurrency control is that you want to keep readers from blocking
cues.zh: 这些是使用多版本并发控制的数据库系统。多版本并发控制背后的思路是，让读操作不会阻塞。

cues.en: writers.
cues.zh: 作者。

cues.en: And the way you do that is you keep old versions of the data around to support lingering reads.
cues.zh: 而做到这一点的方法是保留数据的旧版本，以支持 lingering reads。

cues.en: And writers can continue to produce new data and readers will see sort of a snapshot of the world
cues.zh: 写作者可以继续生成新数据，而读者会看到他们启动时世界的一个快照

cues.en: at the time they were started.
cues.zh: 在他们启动的那一刻。

cues.en: That's how Clojure works. It's a snapshot system.
cues.zh: Clojure 就是这样工作的。它是一个快照系统。

cues.en: Which means that if I start a transaction,
cues.zh: 这意味着如果我开启一个事务，

cues.en: all the reads that I do inside that transaction
cues.zh: 我在该事务内进行的所有读取

cues.en: appear to have happened at the same point in time, even though things may have happened since then.
cues.zh: 看起来都发生在同一个时间点上，即使之后可能已经发生了其他事情。

cues.en: It's as if I got a snapshot of the reference world at the point in time my transaction occurred And I will only see
cues.zh: 就好像我在事务发生的那一刻获得了引用世界的快照，我只会看到

cues.en: values of references from that point in time or things that I myself have changed in my transaction.
cues.zh: 那个时间点的引用值，或者我自己在事务中修改过的内容。

cues.en: No other values.
cues.zh: 没有其他值。

cues.en: In addition, if I make changes in a transaction,
cues.zh: 此外，如果我在事务中做了修改，

cues.en: when I commit,
cues.zh: 当我提交时，

cues.en: those changes will appear to happen, for everybody else's perspective, as if they happened instantly at the same point in time. So nothing is spread out over time. You're reading a point in time, you're writing a new point in time.
cues.zh: 从其他人的视角来看，这些修改就好像在同一时间点瞬间发生了。所以没有任何东西是跨越时间展开的。你读取的是一个时间点，你写入的是一个新的时间点。

cues.en: And the effect of that
cues.zh: 这样做的效果

cues.en: from a consumer standpoint is you always see a consistent view of the entire world.
cues.zh: 从使用者的角度来看，就是你始终能看到整个世界的统一视图。

cues.en: Every reference you see inside a transaction, whether you're a reader or a writer.
cues.zh: 你在事务内看到的每一个引用，无论你是读者还是写作者。

cues.en: But the magic of multi version concurrency control is that readers never block writers or other readers.
cues.zh: 但多版本并发控制的魔力在于，读者永远不会阻塞写作者或其他读者。

cues.en: They never block them.
cues.zh: 它们永远不会阻塞对方。

cues.en: So there's a great amount of throughput as writers can continue to proceed.
cues.zh: 所以吞吐量非常大，因为写作者可以继续推进。

cues.en: And writers never block readers
cues.zh: 而写作者也永远不会阻塞读者

cues.en: because when you're reading, you're reading the snapshot point in time. If you're reading time 10 and they produced 11, 12, 13, you don't care. As long as the system can continue to deliver you 10, you'll see the world as of ten.
cues.zh: 因为当你读取时，你读取的是快照时间点。如果你在读时间 10，而他们产生了 11、12、13，你不在乎。只要系统能继续为你提供 10，你看到的就是时间 10 的世界。

cues.en: Okay?
cues.zh: 好吧？

cues.en: It's a very powerful system and it's extremely easy to use.
cues.zh: 这是一个非常强大的系统，而且非常容易使用。

cues.en: It does the right thing.
cues.zh: 它会做正确的事。

cues.en: Wait, there's one other thing. Oh, yeah. And the other thing that the Closure STM does is it supports commute,
cues.zh: 等等，还有一件事。哦，对了。Closure STM 做的另一件事是支持 commute，

cues.en: which is an interesting thing.
cues.zh: 这是个很有意思的功能。

cues.en: Typically,
cues.zh: 通常来说，

cues.en: sometimes some of the changes you need to make are,
cues.zh: 有时候，你需要做的一些修改是，

cues.en: commutative.
cues.zh: 可交换的。

cues.en: Like, you just need to upgrade... Increment a counter or add a value to a sum as a result of your transaction.
cues.zh: 比如，你只需要在事务的结果中更新……给计数器加一，或者给总和加上一个值。

cues.en: Well, there's a way to do that,
cues.zh: 这有一种实现方式，

cues.en: old school, right? Read,
cues.zh: 老办法，对吧？读取，

cues.en: add,
cues.zh: 相加，

cues.en: write back. As soon as you've done that, you've done a writing transaction to something, which means that nobody else could have written it. But if I'm getting something from a feed and you're getting something from a feed and both of our jobs are just to, like, add them to this bucket,
cues.zh: 写回去。你一旦这么做，就对某个东西执行了一次写事务，这意味着其他人都不能再写入它了。但如果我从一个数据流中获取东西，你也从一个数据流中获取东西，而我们的任务都只是把它们加到这个桶里，

cues.en: well, that's commutative. I had something I can add it. You have something you could add it. If I had to read, modify, set it and you had to read, modify, set it, we couldn't cooperate. But since our operations are commutative, I could say, look, when this transaction completes, just add one to this. And you say, When this transaction completes, just add one to that. The order of those two things doesn't matter.
cues.zh: 那就是可交换的。我拿到一个东西，可以把它加进去。你拿到一个东西，也可以把它加进去。如果我必须读取、修改、设置它，而你也必须读取、修改、设置它，那我们就无法协作。但既然我们的操作是可交换的，我可以说：等这个事务完成时，只给这个值加一。你也可以说：等这个事务完成时，只给那个值加一。这两件事的顺序并不重要。

cues.en: And so,
cues.zh: 所以，

cues.en: Closure STM supports commute as a proper operation.
cues.zh: Closure STM 将 commute 作为一种正式操作来支持。

cues.en: All right, agents. Wow, sounds funny.
cues.zh: 好了，agents。哇，听起来真有意思。

cues.en: Agents manage independent state. The idea here is that there's a piece of state,
cues.zh: agents 管理独立的状态。这里的想法是，有一块状态，

cues.en: an agent is responsible for it, you can get that state to change by sending the agent
cues.zh: 由一个 agent 负责，你可以通过向这个 agent 发送

cues.en: an action.
cues.zh: 一个操作来改变这块状态。

cues.en: An action is an ordinary function. It says take whatever your state is, apply this function to it, and that's your new state.
cues.zh: 动作就是一个普通函数。它表示：拿到你当前的状态，把这个函数作用上去，得到的就是新状态。

cues.en: The trick is,
cues.zh: 诀窍在于，

cues.en: you send actions to agents
cues.zh: 你向代理发送动作

cues.en: using a function called send or send off.
cues.zh: 使用一个叫 send 或 send off 的函数。

cues.en: That send, it returns right away. And what ends up happening is that request for the change gets queued up in that agent.
cues.zh: 那个 send 会立刻返回。结果就是，这个变更请求会被排进那个 agent 的队列里。

cues.en: And eventually,
cues.zh: 最终，

cues.en: asynchronously
cues.zh: 异步地

cues.en: in a thread pool, that action will happen.
cues.zh: 在线程池中，该操作将会发生。

cues.en: This is for a much looser kind of concurrency updating
cues.zh: 这适用于一种宽松得多的并发更新方式

cues.en: caches,
cues.zh: 缓存，

cues.en: updating incrementers,
cues.zh: 更新增量器，

cues.en: independent workers.
cues.zh: 独立的工作线程。

cues.en: It has a very high degree of independence. The nice thing about it is somebody else requests change and they immediately
cues.zh: 它有非常高的独立性。好处在于，别人提出变更请求后，他们马上

cues.en: continue their work. The change happens eventually
cues.zh: 继续他们的工作。变化终将发生

cues.en: in a separate thread pool. The agent system under the hood makes sure that no more than one action is happening per agent at a time. So all the activities on an agent are serialized by the system. That would be the hard part if you were going to try to do it yourself.
cues.zh: 在一个单独的线程池中。底层的智能体系统会确保每个智能体同一时间最多只执行一个动作。因此，一个智能体上的所有活动都由系统串行化。如果你要自己实现这一点，那会是困难的部分。

cues.en: So this beautiful non blocking way, say, Do this work, and you know it will happen. If you say from a single source, Do this, do that, do the other, this, that, the other will happen in order.
cues.zh: 所以这种漂亮的非阻塞方式，比如说，做这项工作，你知道它会发生。如果你从单一来源说，做这个、做那个、做另一个，这个、那个、另一个会按顺序发生。

cues.en: The cool thing about agents in closure versus, for instance, ACTR systems like Erlang,
cues.zh: 在Clojure里使用代理，相比比如Erlang这样的ACTR系统，有个很酷的地方，

cues.en: is that the state is always available. If I want to go and see what the state of the sky is, I can just access it. It may not be,
cues.zh: 就是状态始终可用。如果我想去看看天空的状态，直接访问它就行。它可能并非如此，

cues.en: may not reflect all the actions that have been sent to it yet, but if you're using agents it's because that doesn't matter to you.
cues.zh: 可能还没反映出已经发给它的所有操作，但如果你在用 agent，那就说明这对你来说无所谓。

cues.en: But it's extremely convenient versus,
cues.zh: 但和……相比，它极其方便，

cues.en: systems where you have to make a request for a change and then make a request that somebody sends you a message back that something happened,
cues.zh: 在那种系统里，你得先请求做一项更改，然后再请求别人发消息回来告诉你某事已经发生，

cues.en: which is how you have to do it in Erlang.
cues.zh: 在 Erlang 里你就得这么做。

cues.en: There are lots of other cool features in Agents in particular. Sometimes you'd like to make sure that the work you asked for gets done. There's a way to do that using await.
cues.zh: Agents 里还有很多其他很酷的特性。有时你想确保自己请求的工作确实完成。可以用 await 做到这一点。

cues.en: So if you put in a wait message in a queue, you will block.
cues.zh: 所以如果你在队列里放一条等待消息，你就会阻塞。

cues.en: And when
cues.zh: 而当

cues.en: the agent gets to that point in the queue, you will unblock.
cues.zh: agent 在队列里执行到那个位置时，你就会解除阻塞。

cues.en: So I can say, do this, that, and the other thing, await.
cues.zh: 所以我可以这么说：做这个、那个，还有另一件事，await。

cues.en: Now I will wait for you to do those things and come back. So there is some coordination available.
cues.zh: 现在我会等你做完这些事再回来。所以是有一些协调机制的。

cues.en: If
cues.zh: 如果

cues.en: you have an agent's action sends other actions to agents, which is kind of a neat thing to be able to do, those
cues.zh: 你让一个 agent 的动作向其他 agent 发送其他动作——这是挺不错的能力——那些

cues.en: dispatches get
cues.zh: 派发会

cues.en: sent after the agent's state has changed. So you can know, I've successfully done this and now I'm ready to have you do the next step. Go do the next step.
cues.zh: 在 agent 的状态改变之后才发送出去。所以你能知道：我已经成功做完这个，现在准备好让你做下一步了。去执行下一步吧。

cues.en: That happens in order. If you were to try to write in your program, you would see that you can't actually write it in that order, but the
cues.zh: 这会按顺序发生。如果你试着在自己的程序里按这个顺序写，你会发现其实没法那样写，但

cues.en: agent system will make it happen in that order,
cues.zh: agent 系统会让它按那个顺序发生，

cues.en: which is useful.
cues.zh: 这很有用。

cues.en: Agents cooperate with transactions.
cues.zh: Agents 会和事务协作。

cues.en: They are a way to achieve
cues.zh: 它们是一种实现

cues.en: once only side effects in transactions because what happens is if you dispatch,
cues.zh: 事务中只执行一次副作用的方法，因为实际发生的是：如果你派发，

cues.en: an action inside a transaction,
cues.zh: 一个事务内的动作，

cues.en: that will only get sent
cues.zh: 它只会在

cues.en: if and when the transaction commits.
cues.zh: 事务提交时才会被发送。

cues.en: So even though the transaction may get retried and you think you're sending this message over and over, you really aren't. It will only ever get sent once. So if you wanted to tie some side effect to that, you could.
cues.zh: 所以即使这个事务可能会被重试，你以为自己在反复发送这条消息，其实并没有。它只会被发送一次。所以如果你想挂上一些副作用，也是可以的。

cues.en: You can't use like a wait in a transaction? Transaction?
cues.zh: 在事务里不能用 wait 吗？事务？

cues.en: Oh,
cues.zh: 哦，

cues.en: right, yeah, no you can't do that. I mean generally blocking in transactions is a problem because you're in a transaction and you're trying to get your work done and get out.
cues.zh: 对，是的，不行，你不能这么做。我的意思是，在事务里阻塞通常是个问题，因为你在事务中，你想把活干完然后出去。

cues.en: Yeah, any blocking operation.
cues.zh: 是的，任何阻塞操作都不行。

cues.en: It's important to note also that all these features like for instance transactions,
cues.zh: 另外要注意的一点是，所有这些特性，比如事务，

cues.en: you don't need closure threads to do that. You can do the closure transactions on any thread. You can dispatch
cues.zh: 你不需要闭包线程来实现。你可以在任何线程上执行闭包事务。你可以用 Java 的 Executors 框架派发

cues.en: operations with Executors framework in Java and run closure transactions on those threads. You can run closure transactions on
cues.zh: 操作，并在那些线程上运行闭包事务。你也可以在

cues.en: the UI thread of Swing.
cues.zh: Swing 的 UI 线程上运行闭包事务。

cues.en: I don't need to own the thread for this to work.
cues.zh: 我不需要独占这个线程才能让它工作。

cues.en: But I would prefer
cues.zh: 但我更希望

cues.en: that you not call agents actors
